title: The role of IRF-1 in mediating T-cell immune imbalance in systemic lupus erythematosus and the construction of a diagnostic model.
authors: Huang, Zichen; Zhao, Cheng; Qin, Fang; Zheng, Leting
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用转录组和机器学习构建SLE诊断模型，虽涉及IRF-1转录因子，但核心是免疫分型与诊断标志物，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), characterized by immune dysregulation, urgently requires improved diagnostic tools and mechanistic insights. The role of interferon regulatory factor-1 (IRF-1) remains unclear. We integrated single-cell transcriptomes (scRNA-seq; GSE254176), 6 bulk transcriptomic datasets (1079 SLE patients, 137 controls, GSE72326 and GSE61635 were merged as training datasets, including 256 SLE patients and 50 controls), and clinical samples (70 SLE patients and 58 controls). IRF-1 dynamics in T-cell subsets were analyzed via clustering and pseudotemporal trajectory. Diagnostic genes were identified by intersecting single-cell-derived IRF-1-associated markers with SLE differential genes, followed by feature selection. Six machine learning models were trained and validated in four independent cohorts. scRNA-seq revealed significant downregulation of IRF-1 in T-cell subsets (central memory CD8(+), Th17) during active SLE, with compensatory overexpression in remission-validated clinically. Cross-analysis identified four IRF-1-correlated diagnostic genes: CCR7, CD274, KLRB1, and NRCAM, that are enriched in MAPK signaling and immune receptor activity. Generalized linear model (GLM) and partial least squares (PLS) models achieved superior diagnostic accuracy across validation cohorts. Immune analysis revealed decreased numbers of resting CD4(+) memory T cells and Tregs (P < 0.01), alongside expanded proinflammatory cells (M1/M2 macrophages, neutrophils; P < 0.01). IRF-1 regulates T-cell differentiation and contributes to SLE immune imbalance. The IRF-1-associated gene-based machine learning model provides a robust, noninvasive diagnostic tool.
abstract_zh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）以免疫失调为特征，迫切需要改进的诊断工具和机制性见解。干扰素调节因子-1（IRF-1）的作用仍不清楚。我们整合了单细胞转录组（scRNA-seq；GSE254176）、6个批量转录组数据集（1079例SLE患者，137例对照，其中GSE72326和GSE61635合并作为训练数据集，包括256例SLE患者和50例对照）以及临床样本（70例SLE患者和58例对照）。通过聚类和伪时间轨迹分析了T细胞亚群中的IRF-1动态变化。通过将单细胞来源的IRF-1相关标记与SLE差异基因相交集，随后进行特征选择，鉴定了诊断基因。六个机器学习模型在四个独立队列中进行了训练和验证。scRNA-seq显示，在活动性SLE期间，T细胞亚群（中央记忆CD8(+) T细胞、Th17）中IRF-1显著下调，并在缓解期经临床验证出现代偿性过表达。交叉分析确定了四个与IRF-1相关的诊断基因：CCR7、CD274、KLRB1和NRCAM，这些基因富集于MAPK信号传导和免疫受体活性。广义线性模型（GLM）和偏最小二乘（PLS）模型在验证队列中实现了优越的诊断准确性。免疫分析显示，静息CD4(+)记忆T细胞和Tregs数量减少（P < 0.01），同时促炎细胞（M1/M2巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞）扩增（P < 0.01）。IRF-1调节T细胞分化并促成SLE免疫失衡。基于IRF-1相关基因的机器学习模型提供了一种稳健、非侵入性的诊断工具。
